story.title: US citizen charged after GrapheneOS phone wipes during airport search

draft:
I'm following a case where a US citizen is being charged after his GrapheneOS phone wiped itself during an airport search. 
The phone's automatic wiping feature is designed to protect user data. 
This raises questions about device security and law enforcement access. 
What are the implications for phone security in such situations?
#GrapheneOS #PhoneSecurity #DigitalRights
